entities.name: Raoul II of Brienne, Count of Eu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raoul II of Brienne was the son of Raoul I of Brienne, Count of Eu and Guînes and Jeanne de Mello. He succeeded his father in 1344 as Count of Eu and Guînes, as well as in his post as Constable of France.
